subject: corridor
fact: The corridor has a stone floor with bodies in Earth Temple brown and Fire Temple red, already cooling in the scalding scalding air.
source_quote: Stone floor. Bodies in Earth Temple brown and Fire Temple red, already cooling in the scalding air.

subject: corridor
fact: The corridor contains an improvised barricade of pews and rubble.
source_quote: Bugbears behind an improvised barricade of pews and rubble,

subject: bugbears
fact: Bugbears are behind the barricade holding the stairway against an Earth Temple advance.
source_quote: Bugbears behind an improvised barricade of pews and rubble, holding the stairway against an Earth Temple advance

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple has an advance that has stalled in the haze ahead of the party.
source_quote: holding the stairway against an Earth Temple advance that had stalled somewhere in the haze ahead of us.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple line fractures after the barricade is destroyed.
source_quote: the Fire Temple line fractured into the exact kind of chaotic mess that we had specifically engineered this situation to produce.

subject: gray ooze
fact: The steam is generated by elemental violence that is not winding down.
source_quote: Elemental violence has a way of feeding itself, and whatever was generating this particular environmental nightmare was not winding down.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr puts an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor.
source_quote: Zephyr put an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor

subject: Zinnia's strike
fact: Zinnia strikes and drops the cultist at the front of the line before the bugbears process her presence.
source_quote: The cultist at the front of their line didn't see me coming. ... The cultist dropped before the bugbears had finished processing that we were there.

subject: Zinnia's injury
fact: Zinnia takes a critical blow that reorganizes her understanding of the fight.
source_quote: The blow took something real from what remained, landing on a body that had just committed fully to the attack and had nowhere to go.

subject: Calmer's divine radiance
fact: Calmer releases a pulse of guiding radiance that causes the double doors at the barricade to stop existing as an obstacle.
source_quote: A single pulse of guiding radiance, the kind of divine light that doesn't ask permission, and the double doors at the barricade simply *stopped existing as an obstacle*.

subject: barricade destroyed
fact: The barricade is destroyed when the double doors fly open.
source_quote: They flew open with the kind of finality that makes everyone on both sides pause for half a breath.

subject: Zephyr kills first bugbear
fact: Zephyr works through the first bugbear with methodical efficiency.
source_quote: I watched Zephyr work through the first bugbear with a methodical efficiency that I don't say enough good things about.

subject: Sequoia kills second bugbear
fact: Sequoia delivers a finishing blow on the second bugbear with satisfying weight.
source_quote: Sequoia's finishing blow on the second had a certain satisfying weight to it.

subject: Air Temple passage
fact: The Air Temple passage is dark and contains a wraith drifting ahead.
source_quote: I came around the bend into the Air Temple passage and there it was, drifting in the dark ahead of us.

subject: wraith
fact: A wraith is present in the Air Temple passage and resists two attempts of divine light from Calmer.
source_quote: The wraith looked at it. And did not flinch. ... The wraith held against it again.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer channels divine light from St. Cuthbert, Cudgel of Ortho, the Arbiter Eternal, twice against the wraith.
source_quote: I gathered the light. I thrust it outward — the real thing, the genuine article, the power that has cracked ghoul skulls and sent lesser dead screaming into whatever passes for oblivion on the other side. ... I tried again.

subject: St. Cuthbert
fact: St. Cuthbert is referenced as the deity whose training guides Calmer’s response to undead.
source_quote: I knew before I turned the corner. Not by sight or sound — by the particular wrongness that St. Cuthbert's training leaves in a cleric who has seen enough of what shouldn't exist.

subject: St. Cuthbert
fact: St. Cuthbert is referred to as the Cudgel of Ortho and the Arbiter Eternal.
source_quote: The divine light of St. Cuthbert, Cudgel of Ortho, the Arbiter Eternal, dispersed twice into the air of a dank dungeon corridor

subject: wraith speaks
fact: The wraith says, 'Well, one of you is going to die today.'
source_quote: the wraith ... said, with what I can only describe as serene confidence: "Well, one of you is going to die today."

subject: Zephyr shoots wraith
fact: Zephyr raises his pistol and wounds the wraith across its torso.
source_quote: Zephyr raised his pistol. The shot caught the wraith across what might generously be called its torso — a wound that barely registered on something like this

subject: party flees
fact: The party begins dashing through the Air Temple corridor in a non-tactical retreat.
source_quote: The party began dashing. One by one, boots loud on stone, the Air Temple corridor filling with the very specific sound of adventurers not fighting a tactical retreat but simply *running*.

subject: Calmer is struck by wraith
fact: The wraith reaches out and catches Calmer across the back with a cold, deep blow.
source_quote: The wraith reached out as I sprinted and caught me across the back. A blow that cost something real, cold and deep,

subject: Calmer is struck by fire bolt
fact: A stray bolt of fire adds insult to Calmer’s injury as he clears the threshold.
source_quote: and then a stray bolt of fire from somewhere in the chaos added its own insult on top

subject: wraith laughs
fact: The wraith laughs hysterically as the party escapes up the stairs.
source_quote: came the sound of the wraith laughing at me. *Hysterically.* It laughed at me *hysterically*.

subject: corridor
fact: The corridor where ghouls ambush the party smells of wet rot and something unnatural.
source_quote: The smell arrived before the sound. That sick, wet rot — like meat left in standing water, but with something worse underneath it, something that didn't belong to the natural world at all.

subject: ghouls
fact: Four ghouls emerge from the dark, shambling in a line.
source_quote: They came out of the dark in a shambling line — four of them

subject: ghouls
fact: The ghouls are former Earth Temple members, recently raised.
source_quote: Earth Temple members. People we'd seen in corridors, nodded to while maintaining cover, filed away as *useful* or *obstacle* in the ongoing arithmetic of survival. Now raised by something with necromantic ambitions

subject: Sequoia's trap fails
fact: Sequoia’s trap mechanism fails early, and the ghouls keep coming.
source_quote: the mechanism failed at the worst possible moment — the kind of failure that makes you want to reconsider your life choices. The spring went early, the delay was nothing, and the ghouls kept coming.

subject: Zephyr kills first ghoul
fact: Zephyr kills the nearest ghoul with a clean, precise dagger strike before it can react.
source_quote: The dagger was already in my hand. Clean. Precise. The creature dropped where it stood like someone had simply switched it off.

subject: Calmer unleashes divine power on ghouls
fact: Calmer releases divine power that causes the three remaining ghouls to flee in terror.
source_quote: Calmer let the undead have it. The holy wrath came out of him like something that had been stored under pressure for weeks. It hit the room — all three remaining ghouls unable to hold against it, every last one of them — and they *fled*.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer says 'yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!' as he channels divine power against the ghouls.
source_quote: Calmer was going "yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!"

subject: Sequoia kills last ghoul
fact: Sequoia puts an arrow in the back of the last ghoul before it escapes the corridor.
source_quote: Sequoia put an arrow in the back of the last one before it made it out the corridor.

subject: Calmer's transformation
fact: Zephyr wonders whether Calmer's outburst against the ghouls is him or something else wearing his voice.
source_quote: The second thought was quieter and I didn't linger on it. The second thought was: *is that him, or is that something else wearing his voice?*

subject: necromantic presence
fact: Someone with necromantic power is working in the dungeon, using corpses of Earth Temple members.
source_quote: Someone with necromantic power was working in this dungeon right now, during our carefully engineered war, with access to our people's corpses and apparent interest in deploying them.

subject: Romag
fact: Romag is referenced in Zephyr's thoughts as part of the operation's context.
source_quote: thinking about Romag and Hartsch and the seventeen ways this whole operation could collapse before morning.

subject: Hartsch
fact: Hartsch is referenced in Zephyr's thoughts as part of the operation's context.
source_quote: thinking about Romag and Hartsch and the seventeen ways this whole operation could collapse before morning.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor is referenced as having drowned Calmer with magic.
source_quote: He has been burned by fire priests and drowned by Thalsor's magic

subject: Calmer revived
fact: Calmer was revived at considerable cost by someone who claims not to care about him.
source_quote: I have been killed once already in this gods-forsaken temple, revived at considerable cost to someone who claims not to care about me

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia expressed concern that Calmer was going native.
source_quote: the concern Zinnia had put into words once, something about Calmer going native
